title: Wheel zoom cannot be turned off
foundBy: session agent of a consuming timeline page; relayed by the repository owner

evidence.verified: The browser test that leaves the ctrl wheel to the browser passes. With `wheelZoom={false}` a Ctrl wheel is not default-prevented and the scale is unchanged. A plain wheel is still consumed and scrolls the axis. On the consuming page a Ctrl wheel of 600 units at the run view leaves the view at the run. `npm run ci` passes on 791cdaa, with every gate run. The visual gate passes 116 of 116 captures with no differing pixel and no new axe finding. The positioned fixture was re-recorded in 8566fe8. The dense, multi-lane and bar fixtures of the index layout are byte-identical to the baseline before this work. The build was served through `npm run registry:npmrevs` as 0.3.1-dev.20260922083722.8566fe8 and installed into the consuming dispatch viewer. That viewer's run14-1 render was measured in headless Chromium at 1500 by 1000.

resolution: `wheelZoom={false}` leaves a Ctrl or Cmd wheel, and a pinch, to the browser. The plain wheel still scrolls sideways.
details:
In the positioned layout a Ctrl or Cmd wheel, and a trackpad pinch, always zoom about the pointer. A page that zooms by preset alone, so that every view it shows is one it can name, has no way to leave the wheel to the browser.

The consuming page stops the Ctrl and Cmd wheel in the capture phase on a wrapper, before the component's own listener sees it. An option is wanted. The plain wheel should keep scrolling sideways.
